ns2:course.label: Intermediate Lingala I
ns2:course.description: Survey of more advanced grammar, with emphasis on increasing conversational fluency, composition skills, study of written texts in the standard and spoken Lingala dialects, and discussion of grammatical variations. Participation in language laboratory may be required. Same as AFST 413. Summer 2008: 5 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Fall 2008: 4 hours only. Prerequisite: LGLA 202.
